content: Community bash statuslines: single-file scripts; input=$(cat); jq -r extraction with // 0 or // empty fallbacks; segment-per-variable then assembled with conditional [ -n ] appends; ANSI vars defined once; git via git rev-parse --git-dir guard then branch --show-current + diff --numstat counts; multi-line output = one echo per line; hide segments when data absent. ohugonnot script adds OAuth usage API + cached JSON + flock. Docs example uses one jq call per field (slow: N processes); better community pattern is a single jq emitting all fields (TSV or null-delimited) read into bash vars in one pass.
